title: Story Progression — Door to Darkness
note: Source of truth for mission order and the keyblade gate. story_progress is stored in SaveRecord and persisted by SaveSystem.

master_gate.rule: Zero cannot wield a keyblade until after mission two, when the flashback with Sora on the drowned shore grants the Inheritance by witness.

missions.name: The Traverse Door
missions.lore: Sealing the second door shakes something loose. Zero watches a boy on a drowned shore draw a Keyblade in the sand — and the Inheritance lands. From here, keyblades answer him.

missions.name: The Door Sanctum
missions.lore: The Door Sanctum lies beyond the district. Zero walks it with the Twilight Keyblade at his side — and, still, the twin red sabres at his hips.
